note: Live market/odds feeds that enrich candidates.json with a real market price per horse. Config-driven and fail-safe, exactly like scrapers/sources.json: fill `url` with a CSV or JSON feed and set the column/field map; leave `url` empty and the feed is a no-op (the app falls back to its model market estimate). Runs inside the bloodstock-scan Action, which has internet; the dev sandbox does not, so a feed URL is validated by a CI run, not locally. Enable with FEEDS=1 in the scan workflow.
app_fields: name (match key), marketGns (live market/hammer estimate in guineas), liveOdds (decimal or fractional, informational), orLive (latest official rating), ts (feed timestamp)
auth: Per source: set `authEnv` to the name of an env var holding a bearer token, or `basicEnvUser`/`basicEnvPass` for HTTP basic auth. Secrets live in GitHub Actions, never in this file.

sources.name: TheRacingAPI forecast prices
sources.why: Racecard forecast/live prices for runners entered to race. Maps a horse name to its current market odds; marketGns is left to the model unless the feed also carries a sale/market value.

sources.name: Generic market CSV
sources.why: Drop-in for any exported market sheet: a CSV with a horse-name column and a market/odds column. Column names are aliased to the app's fields so a raw export ingests without renaming.

sources.name: Example market CSV (offline file)
sources.why: Worked example + no-network path: with no `url`, the adapter reads feeds/data/<file>. Set enabled:true to feed it. Delete once a real feed is wired.
